brief:
Israeli forces opened fire on Palestinians near al-Ram, a town north of occupied Jerusalem, as military vehicles moved into the area, the Wafa news agency reported. The circumstances that prompted the gunfire remained unclear, and immediate reports did not specify whether there were casualties or injuries from the incident.

The shooting marks the latest in a series of confrontations in the occupied West Bank. Tensions between Israeli military forces and Palestinian communities in the territory have remained elevated, with clashes and security incidents recurring across various locations. Al-Ram, situated near the Jerusalem municipal boundary, has been a flashpoint for such incidents in recent months.
